en: A vintage illustrated postcard featuring large, detailed strawberry plants with red berries dominating the design. Inset within one of the leaves is a small vignette of an architectural site labeled "Türkenbrunnen," showing a pavilion-like structure with columns and a walkway beside a building on a hillside, with a small figure in front. The word "GRAZ." appears at the top left, and there is small printed publisher information along the left and right margins.
